WITH valid_analyses AS (
  SELECT ab.abhvreg, t.tradekind
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM valid_analyses
),
analysis_by_trader_type AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as count_analyses,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as share
  FROM valid_analyses
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
avg_count_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(count_analyses) as avg_count FROM analysis_by_trader_type
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    count_analyses,
    share,
    count_analyses - (SELECT avg_count FROM avg_count_value) as excess
  FROM analysis_by_trader_type
  WHERE count_analyses > (SELECT avg_count FROM avg_count_value)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(count_analyses) as sum_counts,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_average;
